commands.name: add-todo
commands.title: Add Todo List
commands.subtitle: Todo
commands.description: Adds a new todo list from a pre-existing file, or creates a new file in the specified directory.

commands.name: view-todo
commands.title: View Todo List
commands.subtitle: Todo
commands.description: Views the currently active todo list. The active todo list can be changed using the "Change active todo list" command.

arguments.name: name
arguments.title: Name
arguments.description: The name of the todo list to view.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
